title: Cloudflare web search for AI agents costs $0.25 to $7 per 1,000 requests
source_used: PPC Land (relaying a Cloudflare blog post)
key_facts: Cloudflare released a Web Search API inside AI Gateway on 2 Oct 2026, according to a post by Michelle Chen, Sam Else and Gabriel Massadas.
Queries from AI agents go to Ceramic.ai, Exa or Linkup, whose crawlers must meet Cloudflare's verified-bot rules.
Searches appear in AI Gateway logs, draw down the gateway credit balance and are offered at the providers' list prices with no markup; bring-your-own-key is supported.
A request takes a query of 1 to 1,024 characters and returns 1 to 10 results; Ceramic.ai is the default provider.
PPC Land computes a 28-fold spread between cheapest and dearest entries; 20 searches would cost between half a US cent and 14 cents at list prices.
The post does not say whether the product is in beta or generally available, and gives no latency, freshness or quality figures.
Native Server Tools for web search are coming to AI Gateway with no date given.
quote_evidence: Cloudflare on October 2, 2026 released a Web Search API inside AI Gateway, sending queries from AI agents to Ceramic.ai, Exa or Linkup and obliging each provider's crawler to meet the company's verified-bot rules.
The post does not say whether the product is in beta or generally available, which plans can use it or where.
Cloudflare is not building an index for this product.
why_it_matters_hint: Developers can buy agent web search through Cloudflare's existing billing and logging, and site owners get promises on crawler identification.
notes: Relayed by PPC Land from Cloudflare's own blog post and documentation. Event older than 4 Oct. Also in the 2 Oct pool (Cloudflare Blog).
